📋 Pre-Enroll for Upcoming Intake
Check this to create a pre-enrolled student. They will be able to log in and see their name and all tabs, but content will be locked with a "Pay registration fee" message until admin marks them as registered.
The Total Fees / Amount Paid fields above are used as their registration fee — the student pays the outstanding balance via mobile money to unlock their account automatically.
WhatsApp group per intake
Registered students (those who paid registration) see a green “Join your WhatsApp group” button at the top of their portal. They get the link for their own intake month. Students whose intake has no link get the default link, if you set one.
Certificates
Students who pass can download their own certificate. Here you see who has collected and who has not. Tap Download to print one for a student who cannot download it.
All ticked certificates come out in one PDF, one per page. The first button leaves the seal space empty so you can press your physical raised seal.
Graduation and hard copy applications
Set the fees and the graduation date once. Students then apply and pay on their certificate page. In the list above, use the "All certificates" filter to see who applied and paid for graduation (hired or bought gown), tick them and print. Leave both fees empty to switch this off.
Student paid in cash? Tick them in the list above, then:
More options (print many, graduation, signatures, types)
For the ticked certificates
Check or cancel a certificate
Type the serial number printed under the barcode. Revoke makes "Verify it" show REVOKED. Restore undoes it.
Type for each course
Choose once what each course gives: Certificate, Advanced Certificate or Professional Diploma. New certificates use this. Courses you leave alone give a Certificate.
Signatures on the certificate
Use this when the Principal or Registrar changes. Sign with dark ink on plain white paper, take a clear photo or scan, and choose it below. The portal removes the paper background and prints the signature in black. It applies to every certificate you print from now on, including the ones students download.
Principal
Registrar
Orientation video
Paste the link to your orientation video (YouTube, Google Drive, Facebook, or any web link). Registered students see it in their Orientation tab from one day before their intake lessons start (the first working day of their intake month), and it stays there after that. YouTube links play right inside the portal. Remove it to hide it.
📚 Extra course registration
Students can register for more courses (and pay for them) only while this is open. Close it when the registration period ends.
Loading…
🔄 Change of course
Students who have not started learning can swap one of their courses for another (no new fees, payments stay the same) only while this is open. The change happens straight away. Close it when the change period ends.

✎ Change a student's course
Works any time, even after the student has started learning. Fees and payments stay the same.
